source.snippet: I'm using hledger to manage my company's bank account. When I receive a payment, I record a transaction from Income:XXX to Assets:Bank:B1. Later, I create another transaction to reserve the money for taxes... This worked well until I had to switch banks. I want to preserve the history of what actually happened...

problem_statement: Small business owners using plain-text accounting tools (hledger/ledger-cli) struggle to correctly model tax-reservation workflows when switching banks, preserving transaction history while keeping books accurate—a recurring operational pain with real financial compliance stakes.
target_segment: Freelancers and small business owners using plain-text / double-entry accounting tools (hledger, ledger-cli, beancount) to manage company finances
notes: Buyer context: business owner managing real company bank account and tax liabilities. The pain is operational/compliance-critical (wrong books = tax risk). Plain-text accounting has a growing but underserved professional user base willing to pay for tooling. Opportunity: guided workflow templates or a SaaS layer on top of hledger for common small-business scenarios (tax pots, bank switches). Adjacent to existing paid products like Actual Budget.
